programme.title: Aflatoon
programme.desc: To become a millionaire quickly, Raja poses as a professor and lures an rich heiress Pooja, hoping to marry her. But trouble begins when he is blamed for crimes committed by his evil lookalike Rocky.

programme.title: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programme.desc: Prakash marries the daughter of a rich businessman but his father-in-law disapproves of him. For his approval, Prakash plans his wife’s fake kidnapping and her eventual rescue. But the plan goes awry when some real kidnappers enter the picture.

programme.title: Mohabbat
programme.desc: Shekhar is in love with Pooja and would like to marry her. Pooja is the only daughter of Choudhury. Shekhar informs his parents, his dad, and his stepmother, and together they all go to Choudhury's house to finalize the marriage. Shekhar's stepmother asks for a hefty sum as dowry, which the Choudhury is unable to afford, and thus the proposal for marriage is rejected. Choudhury even vows that he will get his daughter married elsewhere. Shekhar is disgusted with his stepmother, and leaves home and comes to Choudhury and attempts to convince him to reconsider. Will Choudhury's stubborness become a problem for the lovers.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: After losing his wife in an accident, a man named Anand gives up his child to a recent widow who has lost her baby. But Anand is caught in a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Amar Akbar Anthony
programme.desc: A family of five is separated in an unfortunate incident. The three brothers are raised in different religious households. As fate would have it, the family reunites after several years and avenges those responsible for their separation.

programme.title: Golmaal Returns
programme.desc: Gopal’s life hits choppy waters when he gets stuck on a yacht for a night upon rescuing an attractive young woman by fighting off some goons. Now, he has his wife suspecting him of having an affair and a police officer on his tail.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul is heavily indebted and has to bring up his two notorious nephews and a niece. One day, the kids go to a carnival and befriend a runaway bride. Trouble ensues when they decide to help her by bringing her home and keep her out of Rahul's sight.

programme.title: Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
programme.desc: Prem, a free-spirited boy, falls in love with a young girl Jenny. However, when he learns that she is in love with her college sweetheart, Rahul, Prem sacrifices his love and helps Jenny to get married to the love of her life.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.
